name: GoodUX
summary: Screenshot library of real onboarding tours, modals, tooltips and in-app messaging, with UX write-ups and a podcast.
description: Appcues' flow gallery collects annotated screenshots of how real products onboard users, announce features, upsell and survey: onboarding checklists, product tours, modal windows, tooltips, slideouts, NPS surveys and mobile flows, sorted into categories and linked to blog write-ups. A 'Behind the Experience' podcast adds interviews, and readers can submit their own examples.
contains: screenshot library of real product flows, including onboarding tours, modals, tooltips and slideouts
categories: onboarding, product tour, modal windows, tooltips, NPS surveys, upsell prompts, mobile apps
each example links to a blog write-up
